q: which host is rank 0 on, and which GPU does it own?
what dominates the runtime?

says.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT rank, stream, t0_ns, t1_ns, max(t1_ns) OVER (PARTITION BY rank, stream ORDER BY t0_ns ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_max FROM timeline_span), g AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_max IS NULL OR t0_ns > prev_max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM o), i AS (SELECT *, sum(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY rank, stream ORDER BY t0_ns) AS island FROM g), islands AS (SELECT rank, stream, island, min(t0_ns) AS a, max(t1_ns) AS b FROM i GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT stream FROM islands GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(b - a) DESC LIMIT 1

q: what is consuming most of the timeline?

says.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT rank, stream, t0_ns, t1_ns, max(t1_ns) OVER (PARTITION BY rank, stream ORDER BY t0_ns ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_max FROM timeline_span), g AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_max IS NULL OR t0_ns > prev_max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new FROM o), i AS (SELECT *, sum(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY rank, stream ORDER BY t0_ns) AS island FROM g), islands AS (SELECT rank, stream, island, min(t0_ns) AS a, max(t1_ns) AS b FROM i GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT stream FROM islands GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(b - a) DESC LIMIT 1

q: when does the first kernel run, relative to the start of the capture?

value.sql: SELECT CAST(((SELECT min(t0_ns) FROM timeline_span WHERE stream='gpu_kernel') - (SELECT min(t0_ns) FROM timeline_span)) / 1000000000 AS BIGINT)
